description: Register of per-port residency assessments. Empty on purpose: the ports and jurisdictions are not named (D-003) and no legal basis has been verified (D-009). A region is not a residency control (HC-01). A port is Established only with a legal basis, a basis other than the region alone, and all eight validations Verified with evidence and a named human verifier. Control plane: agents cannot edit it.

hostingOptions.A: In-country Azure region hosts the cell. Allowed only when residency is Established for that port
hostingOptions.B: In-country Azure region for the shore services plus a jurisdiction-local edge store for the evidence of record
hostingOptions.C: Jurisdiction-local evidence store (edge or on-premises, possibly Azure Arc or Azure Local managed) with a controlled shore integration that carries only flows approved under D-011
hostingOptions.D: Hosted by a partner in the jurisdiction. Needs the same validations and a contract
hostingOptions.None: No hosting option is feasible for this port; escalate

legalBasis.reference: the legal source, cited by counsel

basis: what establishes residency; never the region alone
